speaker: Doctor
text: The mutation on chromosome 9 is actually the BCR-ABL fusion gene, which is diagnostic for Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML), not a JAK2 mutation. I need to confirm the full blood count to see if there is leukocytosis or a left shift typical of CML. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

text: The BCR-ABL fusion gene confirms Chronic Myeloid Leukemia, but the prominent thrombocytosis and abnormal platelets are atypical for the chronic phase. I need to rule out a concurrent Essential Thrombocythemia or Accelerated Phase CML. REQUEST TEST: Bone_Marrow_Biopsy

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of dysplastic megakaryocytes alongside BCR-ABL positivity suggests CML in the accelerated phase. DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia, Accelerated Phase
